desc:
Make your own furry creations and publish them to Roblox! 🐾

🖌️ Paint your creation with brushes, fills and layers
⭐ Add stickers and accessories
👀 Try your creation on before you publish
🚀 Publish it and wear it anywhere on Roblox
🌍 Check out furry creations and outfits from the community when you need ideas
🕺 Try on catalog items, save outfits and test emotes

Publishing costs Robux, and published creations can't be sold. Uploads must follow Roblox's Terms of Use and Community Standards, and inappropriate textures can get your account moderated!

👍 Like and favorite the game! More creation types and tools are on the way.
